context: A police officer briefs a teen reporter on a public-safety incident
purpose: Teach: エイズ/原発/悲惨/脆弱/不能/早急/除去/友好

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 昨夜、市内の原発関連施設の近くで悲惨な事故が起きました。
lines.en: Last night, a tragic accident occurred near a nuclear-related facility in the city.
lines.style: Calm, measured tone with formal police diction throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えっ、けが人は出たんですか?学校新聞に載せたいので詳しく教えてください。
lines.en: What? Were there injuries? I want to write about it for the school paper.
lines.style: Eager, slightly nervous teen reporter pressing for details politely

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 幸い死者はいません。古くなった配管の脆弱な部分から薬品が漏れたんです。
lines.en: Fortunately no fatalities. Chemicals leaked from a weakened section of aging piping.
lines.style: Professional, fact-first delivery broken into shorter natural beats

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 薬品って、危険なものですか?触れた人が意識不能になったりとか…
lines.en: Chemicals — are they dangerous? Like, could someone who touched them lose consciousness?
lines.style: Anxious, naive teen worry phrased as a halting follow-up question

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 工業用の溶剤で、感染するエイズのような病原体ではありません。早急に除去作業を進めています。
lines.en: It's an industrial solvent, not an infectious pathogen like HIV. We're urgently carrying out removal work.
lines.style: Patient correction with gentle but authoritative reassurance and calm pacing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。住民との友好的な関係のためにも、ちゃんと情報を出すことが大事ですよね。
lines.en: I see. For friendly relations with residents too, putting information out properly really matters, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, mature insight from a young journalist in casual register

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: その通りです。本日夕方に正式な記者会見を開きますので、君も同席して構いませんよ。
lines.en: Exactly. We're holding an official press conference this evening — you're welcome to attend.
lines.style: Warm professional encouragement, treating teen as legitimate press member

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます!責任を持って、正確な記事を書きます。
lines.en: Thank you so much! I'll write an accurate article and take it seriously.
lines.style: Bright, determined gratitude with renewed sense of purpose
